svg.title: GEX offline inputs, calculation identity and reproducible evidence
svg.desc: Technical architecture derived from docs/architecture.md, docs/model-assumptions.md and docs/research-governance.md. Authorized existing full-session captures enter a separate saved-data path, bounded at 1 GiB and two million events, which verifies a private disk copy, replays one consumer and freezes the final checkpoint. Smaller browser-selected guided intake remains bounded at 4 MiB and five thousand events and freezes a chosen prefix. Terminal explicit handoff freezes an eligible demo/replay state. The same immutable checkpoint model feeds request-local original/scenario calculations through shared engine code. Default and directionalized quantities are evaluated independently. A gamma-vector cache is request-local, bounded at 32 vectors and 2 MiB; the existing American lattice scalar cache is a distinct 4096-entry cross-call LRU. Compact browser results omit repeated contributions and source echoes but retain summaries, matrices, exclusions, pricing coverage, freshness and identities. Full portable receipts are recalculated with embedded source and complete detail and compared by semantic result identity. Experiments and corpus verification are separate research authorities, not automatic prerequisites for all scenarios. Readiness, runtime mode, captured health, pricing coverage, IV age and predictive validity remain distinct. No provider access is part of these saved-data paths.
svg.text: Frozen input → controlled calculation → reproducible evidence
Local browser ↔ capability-protected 127.0.0.1 service · packaged charts, no CDN
Verified chosen prefix; no server path
Compact projection cannot be a receipt
Separate research authority: experiments and corpus
Profiles + input/build identity → deterministic experiments → semantic results
Corpus membership and hash-chain verification remain independent checks.
No automatic corpus prerequisite; integrity does not establish rights or historical authenticity.
Readiness ≠ runtime mode ≠ captured health ≠ pricing coverage ≠ IV observation age
Numerical parity and replay do not establish live readiness or predictive validity.
Derived from architecture, model assumptions and research governance · no provider I/O on these paths
